text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on?
Something about the ranch feels different from usual...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでしょう。
牧場がいつもの雰囲気と違う気がします……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Hanzo must've done something.
We should move ahead with caution.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハンゾウが何かしたのかな。
気を付けて進んでいこうか。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
He's ruining the tranquility of the ranch!
I'll make him pay dearly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
のどかな牧場が台無しよ！
許せないわね！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
We'll jus' have to take him down
an' return the ranch to how it oughtta be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハンゾウたちを倒して、
いつもの牧場を取り戻すべ！！
